_method: Every claim checked against seo-tools/runbook/_facts.md (NexFortis facts) or an independently verified named primary source (third-party stats, verified live via firecrawl 2026-06-22).
fabrication_scan: NONE — no client counts, named client results, testimonials, invented prices, guarantees, awards, or content-removal/ranking-time promises. Reputation-management capabilities (ORM, review generation, monitoring/response, content suppression, brand reputation strategy) are written as NexFortis's approach/process for a service it offers (it has a service page in keyword-ownership.json), not as a track record. The draft explicitly DECLINES to invent guarantees ('We do not invent guarantees or promise that specific content will disappear by a fixed date') and is honest about what cannot be promised ('We cannot promise to delete a legitimate review or remove content we do not control').
